name: Gix
description: An Untouchable who stabbed Glacian and became a compleated Phyrexian of Yawgmoth's Inner Circle.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra, having become the Brotherhood's puppet, is betrayed by them and turned over to Gix.
timeline.quote: Mishra was betrayed by them and turned over to Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix, a human rebel of the Caves of the Damned, ambushes Glacian and stabs him with a powerstone shard, infecting him with phthisis.
timeline.quote: He stabbed Glacian with a powerstone shard

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth cures phthisis and coerces an oath of loyalty from Gix, pacifying his rebellion.
timeline.quote: vowed to serve Yawgmoth faithfully forever

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Phyrexia's founding, Gix is among the first compleated and becomes Yawgmoth's right-hand man in the Thran-Phyrexian War.
timeline.quote: Gix became one of the first living beings to be Compleat ed

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war the Phyrexians are trapped on Phyrexia when Rebbec closes the portal.
timeline.quote: when the Thran architect Rebbec closed the portal connecting Phyrexia to Dominaria

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Brothers' War a demon enters Dominaria, takes over the monks' dreams, and announces himself as Gix at Koilos.
timeline.quote: then announced himself as that very same Gix.

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix manipulates both brothers, fails to kill Mishra because of the Weakstone, and oversees Mishra's Compleation.
timeline.quote: he oversaw Mishra's Compleation, bringing the younger brother fully into Phyrexia's grasp

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix lures both brothers to Argoth, starting the Battle at Argoth.
timeline.quote: He also lured both brothers to Argoth

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza's sylex blast wipes out both armies and forces Gix back to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: forcing Gix to escape back to Phyrexia with a handful of human followers

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weakstone protects Mishra from Gix, who decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
timeline.quote: Gix then decided to corrupt Mishra instead.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Mishra and the Weakstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 36 AR Gix is summoned to Mishra's Fortress, is burned by the Weakstone and decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
timeline.quote: seeking instead to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra is turned over to Gix and compleated before Argoth.
timeline.quote: Mishra was turned over to Gix and compleated

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos while she holds Gix back.
timeline.quote: They were attacked by Gix , but Ashnod passed the Sylex to Tawnos

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha meets Gix, receives her name and chooses a female identity as rebellion; he fails to break her mind.
timeline.quote: Xantcha thus had gained both her name and her gender from her first meeting with Gix.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The first newts are found out and killed by Dominaria's inhabitants, and assignments stop; Xantcha is forgotten.
timeline.quote: Xantcha, largely forgotten, waited for an assignment that never came.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Shard of Twelve Worlds closes Phyrexia off from Dominaria, and Yawgmoth harshly punishes Gix as Xantcha watches.
timeline.quote: For this oversight, Gix was harshly punished by Yawgmoth with a grand display that Xantcha personally observed.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha discovers the praetor Gix in a crypt while planting screaming spiders against sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: she went into a crypt where she discovered the praetor Gix.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Gix fight at Koilos; Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves, letting Urza defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: The disruption made Gix pause and gave Urza the chance to defeat him.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix rises to the rank of praetor in the Phyrexian regime.
timeline.quote: Gix rose through the Phyrexian regime to the exalted rank of praetor.

citation.text: Gix (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is created in the Fourth Sphere as a sleeper agent; Gix opens her mind; she sabotages missions and is saved from execution by Urza.
timeline.quote: Xantcha is created as a newt in the Fourth of Nine Spheres to be a sleeper agent sent to Dominaria.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Glimmer Moon activates the spiders, killing nearby sleepers, and Urza chases Gix to Koilos.
timeline.quote: The Moon activates the spiders and all the nearby sleepers are affected and killed.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe free Urza's powerstones, which destroy Gix; both are lost in the explosion.
timeline.quote: Ratepe and Xantcha are lost in the explosion.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod find a portal to Phyrexia in Koilos and are attacked by the demon Gix, then close the portal.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod escape and close the portal.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix reopens the portal and creates the Brotherhood of Gix, becoming Mishra's chief advisor.
timeline.quote: He lures and dominates more humans to create the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza discovers Argoth, Gix feeds the information to Mishra, and both brothers invade the island.
timeline.quote: By chance, Urza discovers the untouched island of Argoth to the southeast

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Sylex and sacrifices herself to delay Gix.
timeline.quote: Ashnod delays him long enough to let Tawnos escape at the cost of her life

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza tells Tawnos that Mishra is dead, killed years earlier by the Phyrexian demon, and says he must leave Terisiare.
timeline.quote: tells him that Mishra is dead but that the demon from Phyrexia had killed his brother years ago

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix silences Xantcha.
timeline.quote: Do not presume to speak for yourself.

citation.text: Oppression (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gix despises the forest, pleased only by the gouge the portal tore.
timeline.quote: Gix despised the sylvan morass.

citation.text: Tainted Aether (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha defies Gix.
timeline.quote: then you'll never control me.

citation.text: Unnerve (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix find their master's severed hand in Koilos.
timeline.quote: they found their master's severed hand.

citation.text: Claws of Gix (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's wrath falls on Gix after the rift cuts Phyrexia off, and Gix is cast into the Punishment Sphere.
timeline.quote: cast down into Phyrexia's Punishment Sphere to be tortured indefinitely

citation.text: "Gix", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves so Urza can defeat Gix in the Sacrifice at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrificed themselves so that Urza could defeat Gix.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Urza and Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra take the powerstone, accidentally reopening the portal to Phyrexia, and Yawgmoth sends Gix to scout.
timeline.quote: Seeing his opportunity, Yawgmoth sent through the Phyrexian demon

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix manipulates both sides of the Brothers' War and compleates Mishra.
timeline.quote: He offered aid and Phyrexian equipment to Mishra, even compleating him.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza defeats Gix at Koilos with the help of Xantcha and Ratepe, both of whom are killed.
timeline.quote: both Xantcha and Ratepe were killed

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The return of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza realizes Gix corrupted Mishra, beginning his lifelong hunt for retribution against Phyrexia and Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza came to realize that Mishra had been completely corrupted by Gix

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe are killed when Urza fights Gix in Koilos; the sacrifice helps Urza defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: Both Ratepe and Xantcha were killed when Urza fought the Phyrexian Demon Gix in Koilos .

citation.text: "Urza", section "Returning home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix declares that praetors decide who is worthy of their works.
timeline.quote: We decide who is worthy of our works.

citation.text: Duress (Arena League 2000, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glacian is stabbed with a powerstone by Gix during a riot in the Mana Rig and falls ill; Rebbec recalls the exiled Yawgmoth to heal him.
timeline.quote: His wife Rebbec uses her influence as the city's main architect to recall the exiled eugenicist Yawgmoth

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth discovers that powerstones cause phthisis; Gix learns it and escapes, wanting vengeance for his people.
timeline.quote: Gix escapes upon hearing this, wanting vengeance for his people.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix leads a massive rebellion, which Yawgmoth quells by offering free serum; he is made a member of the council.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth manages to quell the revolt by offering free serum to the Untouchables.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth uses an artifact based on Glacian's designs and the Halcyte Guard to crush Gix's second riot and bully him into obedience.
timeline.quote: bully Gix into complete obedience.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 2: The Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth discovers phthisis is caused by powerstone radiation and Gix begins rallying the Untouchables to revolt.
timeline.quote: Gix , started rallying his fellow Untouchables to rebel and take vengeance upon the Thran.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth quells Gix's rebellion with free serum and is made a member of the Halcyon council.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth was made a member of the council of Halcyon

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: It is discovered that Yawgmoth is diluting the serum, and he uses the resulting unrest to gain control of the Halcyte Guard.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth used this development to attain more funding and complete control over the Halcyte Guard.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth uses an artifact to control all powerstone technology and forces Gix into obedience.
timeline.quote: he managed to stop the invasion and force Gix into complete obedience.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra disturb the powerstone seal; Yawgmoth sends Gix through to manipulate their war.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth sent Gix , now a fully compleated Phyrexian and a member of his Inner Circle , through the portal as a scout.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, devastating Dominaria; the resulting Shard keeps the Phyrexians out and Yawgmoth has Gix imprisoned in the 7th Sphere.
timeline.quote: A furious Yawgmoth had Gix thrown into the 7th Sphere of Phyrexia, where he would be tortured for all eternity.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell, reopening Dominaria to Yawgmoth; Gix is released but Urza destroys the Sleeper Agents and kills Gix.
timeline.quote: He first destroyed all Sleeper Agents and then killed Gix.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza fights Gix in the Caves of Koilos.
timeline.quote: Urza fights Gix in the Caves of Koilos .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The "Empty Quarter" (3000 AR to 3285 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix finds their master's severed hand in the cave of Koilos and enshrines it.
timeline.quote: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand.

citation.text: Claws of Gix (Time Spiral Timeshifted, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha defies Gix, telling him fear will never control her.
timeline.quote: then you'll never control me

citation.text: Unnerve (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gix stabbed Glacian with a powerstone, making him ill.
timeline.quote: When her husband was stabbed with a powerstone by Gix

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Released after the Shard of the Twelve Worlds is destroyed, Gix commands the Phyrexian incursion into Efuan Pincar.
timeline.quote: Gix was placed in command of the Phyrexian incursion into the small Dominarian nation of Efuan Pincar .

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza destroys the sleeper agents of Gulmany, and Gix flees to Koilos for a final battle with Urza.
timeline.quote: Urza followed him there, and Gix engaged him in a climactic final battle.

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves to disrupt Gix's temporal shift, which implodes on him and annihilates him.
timeline.quote: causing it to implode upon Gix in a blinding inferno and annihilate him at last.

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix tells an agent to give the schematic to the younger brother to keep Argoth's resources from Urza.
timeline.quote: "Give the schematic to the younger brother.

citation.text: Sundering Titan (The Brothers' War Retro Artifacts, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gix pierces his disciples' minds and takes in their knowledge.
timeline.quote: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

citation.text: Diabolic Intent (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In his desperation to destroy Urza, Mishra lets Gix destroy him.
timeline.quote: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

citation.text: Painful Quandary (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mishra returns with Ashnod, reactivates the portal, steps into Phyrexia and brings back three dragon engines but is discovered by Gix.
timeline.quote: Mishra charmed three dragon engines and brought them back to Dominaria

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix guides the Brotherhood of Gix across the desert to reactivate the portal, steps through and gives them his name.
timeline.quote: twelve of them arrived at the caves and reactivated the portal.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix uses Koilos as his base for the rest of the war, manipulating both sides.
timeline.quote: Gix kept using Koilos as his base of operations for the remainder of the war

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The final battle of the Brothers' War takes place on Argoth.
timeline.quote: the final battle of the Brothers' War takes place on the island of Argoth .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Peace talks at Kroog end disastrously and mark the official start of the Brothers' War; the phyrexian demon enters Dominaria as Gix.
timeline.quote: a new peace conference in Kroog also ends disastrously and marks the official beginning of the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Harbin discovers Argoth and the Combined Kingdoms invade it; Gix lures Urza and Mishra there.
timeline.quote: Gix also lures Urza and Mishra to Argoth in order to make them face each other physically.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Gix drives artifact creatures mad, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs.
timeline.quote: Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg to swamp and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age; Urza ascends and Gix retreats to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza activates the Sylex.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth transports more infected from Halcyon to the caves while Gix arranges escapes.
timeline.quote: Gix arranged for several escapes through secret passages

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix stabs Glacian with a powerstone, giving him phthisis; Rebbec recalls Yawgmoth from exile to heal him.
timeline.quote: Rebbec , used her influence in the council to recall the healer Yawgmoth from his exile

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the siege of Sarinth the Brotherhood of Gix brings Gix to the fortress while Mishra plans to move his headquarters to Tomakul.
timeline.quote: Gix was brought by the Brotherhood of Gix to the fortress

citation.text: "Mishra's Fortress", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix finds he cannot murder Mishra and steal the Weakstone, and decides to corrupt Mishra for Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gix decided to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra's Fortress", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ratepe and Xantcha sacrifice themselves at Koilos so Urza can defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: they had to sacrifice themselves, and so they did

citation.text: "Ratepe", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rona leads clandestine excavations in the Caves of Koilos and discovers the charred but living Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: discovered the charred but still living form of the Phyrexian praetor Sheoldred

citation.text: "Rona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 57 AR Sanwell brought Urza news that Mishra planned to come to Argoth physically, information planted by Gix.
timeline.quote: brought the news to Urza that Mishra was planning to come to Argoth physically

citation.text: "Sanwell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Roughly a thousand first-generation newts are sent out after the Brothers' War but are slain by defenders; Gix is punished.
timeline.quote: The praetor Gix was harshly punished for this oversight

citation.text: "Sleeper agent", section "First Generation Sleeper Agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza realizes Mishra has become a Phyrexian and activates the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: Urza used his newly found magical skills to activate the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Sylex Blast", section "Cause". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix stabs Glacian with a powerstone during an Untouchable riot, giving him phthisis.
timeline.quote: Glacian is stabbed by Gix using a powerstone during an Untouchable riot and is afflicted with phthisis .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix leads the first Untouchable uprising, Jonas dies, and Yawgmoth's serum quells it.
timeline.quote: Gix leads the first Untouchables' uprising to take vengeance on the people who afflicted them with phthisis.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix leads a second rebellion, letting Yawgmoth claim emergency power and force Gix into his service.
timeline.quote: this time forcing Gix into his personal service.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
